recommendation.section: Periodicals and the work behind a reference book
suggested_paragraphs: A magazine can preserve a film’s working life beside its publicity. In his account of Chitrapuri, Surya Deo describes special issues bringing together stories, songs, contributor names and first-person experiences. Literature also appeared alongside cinema writing. These are routes into particular issues, rather than substitutes for reading the originals. [reading-chitrapuri-deo]

A reference book makes some of that research labour visible in its opening pages. The Encyclopaedia of Indian Cinema thanks Chandidas Mishra and Samarendra Das among its Odia contributors. Its explanatory notes identify Ghosh’s earlier history and credit Das with compiling later information. Before turning to a film entry, a reader can ask whose records helped put it there. [reading-encyclopedia-method]

For a further archival lead, Indiana University’s finding aid lists a booklet for Shesha drushti, catalogued1997. The entry identifies an object to pursue; it does not put the booklet’s pages before us. [reading-iu-ephemera]
recommendation.reader_value: Distinguish readinganoriginalpage, readingareproduction, andlocatinganitem; encouragecheckingmasthead/date/credits ratherthanassuming a coverestablishescontents.
